headline: "Meat Tickets" Cluster Up as First-Day Gains Fall... Here Is the New Stock Overview
summary: The average first-day gain of new stocks listed in the third quarter fell significantly from the second quarter. High-premium new listings accounted for over 60% of the first three quarters.
why: First-day performance of IPOs signals investor appetite for new listings and the health of China's equity capital-raising market.
